mathematics.assertion_tested: Within explicitly reduced SM third-generation one-loop gravity-step model, solve two Yukawa boundary equations for f_g and f_y without an electromagnetic or hypercharge numerical input; evaluate predicted hypercharge and local parameter-map rank, repeat at two UV cutoffs and two tolerances; evaluate separate crossover sensitivity
mathematics.coefficient_domain: 64-bit floating point SciPy integrations and finite differences
mathematics.conventions: t=ln(mu/mt), beta_g=b*g^3/(16*pi^2)-f_g*g above crossover; universal f_y, two nonzero UV Yukawa fixed points, non-Abelian gauge boundary data supplied independently
inputs: inverse_inputs.json contains y_t,y_b,g2,g3 reference data, masses and declared crossover choices; no alpha_em or gY input
non_claims: Not a full flavor or gravity calculation
Crossover step, measured-coupling matching, thresholds and universal gravity terms are assumptions
